# Retrieve the latest filtered flight results for outbound and return legs
filtered_departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights")
filtered_return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_return_flights")

# Retrieve the latest hotel results for Downtown Raleigh
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Since the user mentioned visiting North Carolina State Capitol, we need to find attractions in Downtown Raleigh
attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Combine the flight results for outbound and return legs into a single list for filtering
all_flights = filtered_departure_flights.search_results + filtered_return_flights.search_results

# Filter flights based on budget and number of layovers (1 layover max)
filtered_flights = filter_flights(prior_results=SearchResultsOutputModel(
    search_results=all_flights,
    query_summary="Combined outbound and return flight results from San Antonio to Raleigh and back."
), budget=300, num_layovers=[1])

# Save the filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Filter hotels based on neighborhood (Downtown Raleigh) and proximity to attractions
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, neighborhood=["Downtown Raleigh"])

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest attraction (North Carolina State Capitol) to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, attractions=attractions, groupBy="attraction")

# Save the nearest attractions to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Sort the filtered flights by price
sorted_flights = sort_results(results=filtered_flights, column="economy_class_price", ascending=True)

# Save the sorted flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_flights", value=sorted_flights)

# Sort the filtered hotels by rating
sorted_hotels = sort_results(results=filtered_hotels, column="rating_hotels", ascending=False)

# Save the sorted hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_hotels", value=sorted_hotels)

# Print the summary of the plan
print("No planning needed")
